ruling: 理 2026-09-14: the >=90% bar was written for a FILTERED pool and Category:唐寅 is unfiltered. Each excluded poem is named here with its reason; the bar applies to the filtered pool and the RAW-pool number is published beside it, never instead of it.
author: 沙汰, 2026-09-14
principle: A poem is excluded only when it is NOT A 近體詩 — a different form, or one text appearing twice. A poem that IS 近體 and breaks a rule stays a FAIL. 出韻 is a fault, not a form, so 子胥圖 stays in and stays failing.

exclusions.title: 宮妃夜游圖
exclusions.evidence: Its rhyme positions 比 and 裏 share 上四紙, a 仄 group; 近體's rules are not its rules. The verifier classifies it automatically.
exclusions.note: This one currently PASSES, so excluding it LOWERS the rate. It is excluded anyway — a 古絕 counted as a passing 七絕 is a poem earning credit for a form it is not in.

exclusions.title: 開門七件事
exclusions.reason: 打油詩, and one text on two pages
exclusions.evidence: 柴米油鹽醬醋茶… — folk verse, fails 粘. Its near-duplicate 除夕口占 is the same poem in variant text (bigram Jaccard 0.636, split_manifest.json).

exclusions.title: 除夕口占
exclusions.reason: 打油詩, and one text on two pages
exclusions.evidence: The second page of the poem above. Counting it twice would let ONE folk poem cost the rate 5.1 points.

explicitly_NOT_excluded.title: 子胥圖
explicitly_NOT_excluded.why: 出韻 — 朝 下平二蕭 against 刀 下平四豪. A genuine fault of a 近體 poem, and 理 ruled it stays a fail.

explicitly_NOT_excluded.title: 孟蜀宮妓圖
explicitly_NOT_excluded.why: 失對 and 失粘 in the text as Wikisource has it. A fault, not a form.

explicitly_NOT_excluded.title: 題畫 (唐寅)#15
explicitly_NOT_excluded.why: 三平調 in hemistich 1. I SUSPECT the text is corrupt (司空幕府通農開 reads oddly) but I have no second edition to show it, and a suspicion is not a reason to drop a poem from a denominator.
